purpose: Teach: 開通/見出す/最優秀/難易/パケット/初版/定数/休止

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新幹線の開通効果を分析しましょう
lines.en: Let's analyze the impact of the Shinkansen opening on our market.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-moving tone. Opens with quiet authority. Even pacing, no hesitation. The voice of someone driving a meeting forward with focus.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客の隠れた要望を見出すよう努めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we identify what customers really need beneath the surface.
lines.style: Attentive and collaborative. Slight lean-in on the commitment. Clear and steady. The affirmation of someone ready to dig deeper, not just execute.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 最優秀部門を表彰しましょう
lines.style: Clear directive, warmth underneath. Straightforward delivery. Light emphasis on 'recognize'—this is good news being announced with genuine approval.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。難易度別に研修を組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll structure the training by difficulty level so everyone can grow at their own pace.
lines.style: Thoughtful and methodical. Takes the direction and shows already-formed thinking. Calm, capable tone. Not rushed—considered.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内ネットのパケット監視を強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen our internal network security protocols.
lines.style: Decisive and measured. No room for debate, but not harsh. The practical voice of someone handling operational risk.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。初版限定の特典を企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll develop an exclusive first-edition bonus program.
lines.style: Brisk, almost eager. Takes the pivot smoothly without questioning. Light energy shift—this is a new idea being integrated instantly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 定数化したルーチンを見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's revisit the routines we've standardized.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Opens slightly slower, inviting reconsideration. The tone of someone who's noticing something that needs adjustment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不採算店舗を一時休止します
lines.en: Yes. I'll put the underperforming locations on temporary suspension.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No emotion needed—this is a practical decision. Clean delivery, quiet confidence in the closure.
